tagline: Industry-standard vector graphics editor for Mac

painPoints.impact: Users who bought lifetime license must now pay yearly

painPoints.problem: Mac-only — no Windows or Linux support
painPoints.impact: Teams using Windows can't use it
Teams struggle to collaborate on designs
Users need separate tools for prototyping

painPoints.problem: Plugin ecosystem is smaller than Figma's

whySwitch: Get a free, web-based design tool with Figma
Get cross-platform support (Mac, Windows, Linux) with Figma
Get real-time collaboration built-in with Figma
Get better prototyping tools with Figma

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.reason: Free tier with unlimited projects, real-time collaboration, and better prototyping
alternatives.description: Figma is the industry-standard UI/UX design tool. The free tier includes unlimited projects and real-time collaboration. It's cross-platform (web-based).
pros: Better than Sketch in most ways
cons: Less powerful vector editing than Sketch (subtle)
alternatives.bestFor: Design teams who want free, cross-platform UI/UX design tool with real-time collaboration

alternatives.name: Penpot
alternatives.reason: 100% free and open-source, with Figma-like interface
alternatives.description: Penpot is a free and open-source UI/UX design tool. It has a Figma-like interface. Completely free — no premium tier. You can self-host it.
alternatives.bestFor: Designers who want a free, open-source UI/UX design tool

alternatives.name: Lunacy
alternatives.reason: Free Sketch alternative with Sketch file support
alternatives.description: Lunacy is a free vector graphics editor that opens Sketch files. It's free for personal and commercial use. Cross-platform (Mac, Windows, Linux).
cons: Less powerful than Figma for collaboration
alternatives.bestFor: Designers who have Sketch files and want a free, cross-platform editor

steps: Export your Sketch files as PDF or SVG
Import Sketch files into Lunacy (direct support) or Figma (SVG)
Rebuild your designs in Figma for better collaboration
Cancel Sketch subscription after confirming Figma meets your needs
tips: Figma is the best free alternative for most users
Lunacy is best if you have many Sketch files
Penpot is best if you want 100% open-source and self-hostable

faqs.question: Is there a completely free alternative to Sketch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Figma has a generous free tier. Lunacy is free for personal and commercial use.

faqs.question: Which Sketch alternative is best for Windows users?
faqs.answer: Figma is the best — it's web-based and works on any OS. Lunacy also has a Windows version.

faqs.question: Can I open my Sketch files in Figma?
faqs.answer: You can export Sketch files as SVG, then import into Figma. Lunacy can open Sketch files directly.
